BrochureContent.Content:
Team Myles O'Donoghue are delighted to present 8 Bramblefield Park, a superb three-bedroom semi-detached family home with the added benefit of a substantial rear extension and a converted attic, offering spacious and versatile accommodation ideally suited to modern family living.

This impressive home enjoys bright, well-proportioned accommodation with a contemporary finish. The standout feature of the property is the exceptional open plan kitchen and dining area, creating the perfect space for both everyday family life and entertaining.

The accommodation briefly comprises an inviting entrance hall, a comfortable living room to the front of the property, guest WC and a stunning open plan kitchen / dining / family room to the rear. The modern fitted kitchen is complemented by a stylish island unit, offering an abundance of storage and workspace while forming the heart of the home.

Upstairs, there are three well appointed bedrooms. The principal bedroom benefits from a modern ensuite shower room, while a contemporary family bathroom completes the first-floor accommodation. The attic has been coverted.

Externally, the property continues to impress. To the rear is a private, low maintenance garden laid in artificial grass, providing an ideal space for outdoor dining and entertaining. To the front, a driveway provides valuable off-street parking.

Bramblefield Park is a mature and highly regarded residential development, ideally located close to an excellent selection of local amenities including primary and secondary schools, shops, cafs, sporting facilities and parks. The Blanchardstown Centre, with its extensive range of retail, leisure and dining facilities, is only a short distance away.

The area is exceptionally well served by public transport, with regular bus services providing easy access to Dublin City Centre. The nearby N3 and M50 offers excellent connectivity to all parts of Dublin and Dublin Airport.
